notes.subject: שלח ... תשלח
notes.rationale: Root שלח appe thrice (incl. ביד־תשלח): 'send... by the hand thou wilt send' — Moses echoes God's own verb back in refusal; TPI keeps salim/salim but loses the single-root echo.

notes.subject: ביד תשלח
notes.rationale: 'By the hand of him whom thou wilt send' (KJV) vs elliptical 'send by the hand [of another]' — TPI renders the supplied relative clause wanpela yu laik salim.

notes.subject: to Adonai
notes.rationale: Moses addresses Adonai directly in polite refusal.

translation: Na em i tok: Plis, Adonai, salim olsem long han bilong wanpela yu laik salim.
